subject.title: Feishu: read image tool result loses media before final outbound payload

question: Which open candidate should own the remaining pathless `read` image media fix for this issue?
rationale: Current main and the latest release still reproduce the source gap, but open candidate PRs already target it with different implementation shapes, so starting another automated fix would create duplicate work.

options.title: Review current-shape PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97442 as the primary candidate because it targets the current `embedded-agent-subscribe` files and broader cross-channel read-image loss.

options.title: Revive narrow fallback PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/50359 if maintainers prefer the smaller start-args fallback and are willing to update it from the old predecessor file structure.

options.title: Close both and request a new PR
options.body: Close the existing candidate PRs only if maintainers want one fresh implementation that combines pathless-image handling with local-media security proof.

recommendation.title: Review current-shape PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97442 as the primary candidate because it targets the current `embedded-agent-subscribe` files and broader cross-channel read-image loss.

likelyOwner.reason: The shared media handoff and predecessor/current agent media files have the strongest history signal for this decision.
